purpose: Collect bounded specialist proposals for missing class starter cards, the Unlit Hollow Crown card/relic presentation collision, and the M0 board-only tutorial enemy. Proposals only; no content is accepted or implemented by this packet.

specialist_roles.deliverable: Propose two missing starter cards each for Ashen Monk and Quarry Witch to meet the v0.2 12-card starter recipe. Provide IDs, names, frame hue, cost, type, rarity, effects, upgrades, board interactions, counterplay, synergy risks and golden tests.

Propose 3–5 alternative display names/presentation treatments for the Unlit Hollow Crown starter card only. Preserve the separate signature relic's canonical name and both entities' IDs/effects. Include lore, readability, localization and UI differentiation.

Propose one original M0 tutorial enemy and a 3–4 turn board-only encounter script teaching group Pop, chip damage, vertical gravity and Wall pressure. No Ink/cards before the spec's fight-2 onboarding beat; show two intents ahead.

constraints: Proposal-only: do not edit production code, content data, ADRs or canonical game spec.
Do not change settled mechanics, class identities, hue count, starter-deck size, progression economy, platform scope or release gates.
Do not import SwapCells/match-3 rules or balance values from the legacy prototype.
Use the exact accepted ADRs as constraints; if a proposal appears to conflict, explain the conflict rather than changing the ADR.
Use original content; do not copy named characters, lore, card text or proprietary systems from other games.
Clearly label facts, inference and assumptions; cite external research sources for any borrowed design principle.
No simulated persona or bot output may be described as human playtest evidence.
acceptance: At least two meaningfully different alternatives for each new card/name/encounter choice.
Every card includes effect text, cost, frame hue, upgrade, board interaction, counterplay and golden-test cases.
Every enemy intent has a telegraph, player counterplay and testable resolution.
Content supports the deck-paints-board pillar and original Emberfall tone.
Cross-system interactions, exploits, degenerate loops and accessibility/readability are checked.
Product Owner accepts/rejects each proposal explicitly before catalogue changes.
dependencies: EFB-001 Product Owner ADR resolution candidate
